disqualifier.note: Independently computed from engine conforms vs result-cap. truncated-and-conforming is representable when maxResults is 0 and report.conforms is true with leftover info/warning results; no exclusive write or exclusive read in this driver.

Independent location vs hostname probes in the URL loader. Combined-true is the blocked-remote-URL case (https to RFC1918/loopback); isUrl is a prefix check and isBlockedRemoteHost is the SSRF host blocklist, not exclusive phases of one stored state.
Independent media-type probes over different inputs (operation descriptor vs response Content-Type). Combined-true is not a state of one object; endsWithSseBoundary is a third buffer-text helper.

Independent type-narrowing probes of unknown failure values (finite number fields vs tagged BoxSdkShapeError). Combined-true is not a state of one object; readers extract numeric context vs tagged SDK shape separately.
Independent guards over different values (Graph path-segment string vs GraphDriveItem name extension). Combined-true is not a state of one object.
Independent probes over different inputs (unknown download-option bag vs URL host vs configured USPTO origin). Combined-true is not a state of one object.

isEntityIdLike is a schema wrapper that consults isNonEmptyString on tableName and entityType. Combined-true is the intended match (an EntityId-like schema); nested helper, not exclusive phases of one stored state.

isReferences consults isFkAction on optional onDelete/onUpdate; combined-true is the intended FK-shape match. Nested author-input guard, not exclusive phases of one stored state. isUniqueKey classifies a different Meta axis.
